name: Video Section
summary: Passive contained or full-width media figure with required target-owned media, optional visible caption, and no neutral playback claim.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native figure grouping one complete target-owned media composition and its optional visible caption.

anatomy.name: wrapper
anatomy.description: Passive media containment region with private aspect ratio, fallback surface and variant-owned radius.

anatomy.name: media
anatomy.description: Required target-owned poster, native video, embed, or complete accessible player composition.

anatomy.name: caption
anatomy.description: Optional native figcaption providing visible editorial context for the media.

variants.name: contained
variants.description: Default padded presentation with rounded media containment.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Intrinsic size filling available component space with a private review-candidate media ratio.

states.name: default
states.description: Passive resting media figure; any player state belongs to the target-owned media subtree.

behavior.name: figureComposition
behavior.description: The root is a native figure and a supplied caption is its native figcaption; the caption provides editorial context rather than synchronized media alternatives.

behavior.name: mediaOwnership
behavior.description: The target owns media type, sources, loading, poster, controls, playback, tracks, captions, descriptions, transcript, errors, provider consent, policy, events and analytics.

behavior.name: omission
behavior.description: Missing required media omits the complete root; an empty optional caption omits only figcaption.

behavior.name: runtimeBoundary
behavior.description: Neutral Web adds no playback action, component state, media API call, listener, observer, request, timer, layout measurement, custom element or authored motion.

properties.name: media
properties.description: Complete target-owned passive media or accessible player composition.

properties.name: caption
properties.description: Optional visible editorial context rendered as native figcaption; not synchronized captions or transcript.

accessibility: Render one complete target-owned media composition inside a native figure and use native figcaption only for optional visible editorial context.
Give informative poster imagery contextual alternative text and hide decorative or redundant imagery with an empty alternative according to target content context.
Do not render a play button, tabindex, action name, pressed state or cursor unless a target supplies a real complete player result.
The target player owns keyboard controls, visible focus, labels, contrast, current playback state, loading and error communication, autoplay policy and media events.
Meaningful media still needs applicable synchronized captions, descriptions, transcript and accessible player support; visible figcaption is not a substitute.
Neutral Video Section adds no authored motion or runtime and leaves provider privacy, consent, loading and analytics with the owning target.

web.notes: Implemented as strict native figure composition with required target media, optional figcaption, contained/full-width CSS and zero neutral runtime or playback claim.

shopify.notes: Copied CSS is available; a dedicated Liquid/schema profile remains blocked on the accepted hosted-versus-external media, captions/transcript, consent, autoplay and fallback policy.
